purpose: Calc Phos 6X......growing pains, bone weakness, fatigue
uses: Helps temporarily relieve: feelings of exhaustion during recovery from illness; discomfort associated with growth-related issues, such as delayed tooth development and recovery from broken bones; and discomfort associated with low iron and thinness.
otcwarn: Keep out of reach of children. If pregnant or breastfeeding, ask a health professional before use. Stop use and ask a doctor if symptoms persist or worsen. If you have severe symptoms, consult a doctor before use.
